cohort: 9823 pregnant women aged 12-55 years with one or multiple live births, covered by Rhode Island Medicaid
finding: Prescription opioid use during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of maternal complications, particularly cesarean delivery, antepartum depression, and cardiac events, especially with high dose exposure.
mod_finding: Opioid-exposed mothers had an increased risk of cesarean antepartum depression and cardiac events.
